title: Kissed Malty Canadian Pistachio Bowl
description: A quick, dairy-free bowl packed with malty quinoa, roasted sweet potato, confit tomatoes and unsalted pistachios, perfect for a bento-box lunch.

ingredients.name: confit tomatoes
ingredients.notes: canned or fresh, simmered with 1 tsp barley malt powder

instructions: Rinse the quinoa under cold water until the water runs clear.
In a saucepan, combine rinsed quinoa and 2 cups of water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until fluffy.
While the quinoa cooks, toss sweet potato cubes with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/4 tsp salt, and a pinch of black pepper, then roast in a preheated oven at 400°F for 20 minutes.
Simmer confit tomatoes in a small pot with 1 tsp barley malt powder for 10 minutes to develop a malty depth.
Sauté spinach leaves for 1 minute in a dry skillet until just wilted.
In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, roasted sweet potato, confit tomatoes, and wilted spinach; toss gently.
Transfer the mixture into a bento-box compartment, leaving space for the topping.
Slice the avocado and arrange on top of the quinoa mixture, then sprinkle with unsalted pistachios, drizzle maple syrup, lemon juice, and a pinch of pepper.
Serve immediately, or store the components separately to keep textures fresh.
